en.title: Growth in 2 Dimensions
en.description: Each operation adds 1 to the rectangle spanning from the bottom-left corner to (r,c); find the number of cells that end up holding the maximum value.
en.input: The first line contains q (1≤q≤100000), followed by q lines, each with positive integers r and c (≤10^9).
en.output: Output the number of cells that reach the maximum value (use a 64-bit integer).
en.explanation: Derive a linear-scan/dynamic-programming solution directly from the problem rules; the examples have been checked case by case against an independently built oracle.
hints: First turn the operations or constraints in the statement into a concrete array/state transition, then analyze the edge cases.
